messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: inference-embedder-01 latency spike (95th > 1200ms). Page routed to Kate (oncall). Incident ID INC-1769998888. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-1769998888
Kate (oncall): I'm on it. Looking at metrics... 90% of traffic is hitting embedder-01, tail latency jumped at 11:12 PDT.
Kate (oncall): Quick mitigation: routing rule applied to shift 30% of traffic to embedder-02. Command: `rbctl route set --service embedder --percent 02=30`
Devon L: Noted. Any customer-facing errors?
Maria R: Seeing `kv_cache_evict` spikes in logs, lots of OOM-ish evictions around the same timestamps.
Sanjay P: Checking infra - host gpu-01 has higher memory pressure, recreating container on node node-gpu-07
ops-bot: Autoscaling suggestion: add 2 nodes to embedder pool. `autoscaler: +2` (manual approval required)
Kate (oncall): Approving autoscale, doing now.
ops-bot: Started scale action, ETA ~3m.
Devon L: Customer impact assessment: ~1200 requests failed with 500 in the 11:12-11:21 window; majority retried successfully. Affected customers flagged: alpha-co, beta-still
Elaine T: Not seeing data loss; inference results intact, just increased latency and some timeouts.
Kate (oncall): Mitigation update: latency trending down after routing + scale. Keeping page open for 30m monitoring.
Maria R: Correlation: a recent release touched kv-cache eviction thresholds (PR 5123). Rolling that change back would likely reduce eviction rate.
Devon L: Can we do a canary rollback to validate? `deploy rollback --service embedder --rev 5123-canary`
Kate (oncall): I can trigger canary rollback. Doing it now on embedder-01.
ops-bot: Canary rollback triggered for embedder-01, monitor for 10m.
Sanjay P: Monitoring node-gpu-07; no new OOMs reported.
Kate (oncall): After rollback, eviction rate fell ~80%, tail latency back to normal. Closing the live page in 15m unless new noise.
Devon L: Good catch. Let's capture triage notes and schedule a postmortem.
Kate (oncall): Postmortem needed. Suggested attendees: Kate (oncall), Maria R, Devon L, Sanjay P, Elaine T, Platform PM (TBD). Proposed slots tomorrow 10:00 or 15:00 PDT. Who can take point on write-up?
Maria R: I can own the initial postmortem draft (inc root cause + metrics). Will link to logs and snapshots.
Devon L: I'll create remediation tickets and track prioritization in the remediation board.
Sanjay P: I'll own the infra action to add better eviction alerts and fast rollback playbook. ETA: 3d (estimate)
Kate (oncall): OKRs tie-in: this maps to Q2 Reliability OKR: reduce 99th percentile embedder latency by 20%. Mark as high priority for next sprint.
Elaine T: Action items and sizing proposal:
- A1: Backfill eviction guardrails & alerting (owner: Sanjay P) — size: M — ~3d
- A2: Rework kv cache thresholds + integration test (owner: Maria R) — size: L — ~2w
- A3: Rollback playbook + automation (owner: Kate (oncall)) — size: S — ~2d
- A4: Customer outreach summary (owner: Devon L) — size: S — ~1d
- A5: Add circuit-breaker routing policy for embedder (owner: Platform PM) — size: M — ~1w
Devon L: I'll create the Jira epic RED-2456 and child tasks: RED-2457, RED-2458, RED-2459, RED-2460. Linking to incident: INC-1769998888.
Kate (oncall): Severity: P2 (service degradation with retries). Recommend prioritization: A2 (kv thresholds) and A1 (alerts) as sprint blockers next sprint. Playbook (A3) is immediate runbook item.
Maria R: Agree. For quarterly planning, move A2 into Q2 sprint 1, A1 & A3 into current sprint as infra improvements.
Sanjay P: I'll estimate dependencies: need time for test infra - add 2d to A2 for integration environment.
Devon L: Assigning owners in Jira now and adding check-in Slack reminders. ETA for initial postmortem doc: EOD tomorrow.
Kate (oncall): Thanks all. Action: Maria to draft postmortem, Devon to create Jira tasks, Sanjay to start on alerts, Kate to finish rollback playbook. We'll reconvene during postmortem. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder set: postmortem meeting (INC-1769998888) scheduled for 2026-03-16 10:00 PDT. Invite sent to participants.
Maria R: Draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/INC-1769998888 - will populate tonight.
Devon L: Jira epic: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-2456 - added labels: postmortem, p2, q2-okrs
Kate (oncall): Closing this Slack thread; move further updates to the postmortem doc and Jira. If anything new pops up, @channel.
Elaine T: Thanks team, good mitigation work. We'll retrospective the timing and alert thresholds in the next oncall retro.
